items.title: Waymo is making its own AI chip for its robotaxi service
items.summary: Autonomous rideshare operator — which is owned by Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) — has begun building its own AI chips to better optimize sensor data, according to Bloomberg. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley examines Waymo's move to bring more of its technology in-house.

items.title: AMD vs. Nvidia: Is AMD Finally Closing the AI Gap?
items.summary: AMD just posted its best quarter ever while Nvidia shipped its way toward a trillion-dollar runway, and now every hyperscaler has to decide whether a credible second source is worth betting on.

items.title: AMD Lost SpaceX to Nvidia. Is Its AI Challenge Already Falling Apart?
items.summary: SpaceX just handed NVIDIA a high-profile win by locking in 20% of its next platform, leaving AMD without a flagship logo at the worst possible moment. The real question is whether this signals a crack in Lisa Su's ambitions or just the cost of competing in a market built on scarcity and politics.

items.title: Can Cerebras' Latest CS-4 Help the Stock in Confronting NVDA & AMD?
items.summary: CBRS CS-4 boosts inference speed and power efficiency as cloud demand surges, while NVIDIA and AMD intensify competition.

items.title: Should You Add NVIDIA Stock to Your Portfolio Ahead of Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: NVDA heads toward its Q2 earnings release with revenues expected near $91 billion as AI, Data Center and Blackwell demand fuel growth prospects.

items.title: Seagate vs. AMD: Which AI Infrastructure Stock Has the Edge?
items.summary: STX's storage-focused AI strategy, HAMR roadmap and valuation give it an edge over AMD in the race to capitalize on AI infrastructure.

items.title: Something Big Could Happen To NVIDIA Stock on August 26
items.summary: NVIDIA reports after the close on August 26, and the setup heading into that print is unlike anything the stock has seen in years. Here is why analysts, prediction markets, and booked backlog all point in the same direction.

items.title: Micron Technology Stock Has Become A Bet On Memory Prices
items.summary: Micron's record revenue arrived on shipments that barely grew, which leaves the price of memory carrying the entire case.
